div.div: 2 لحّج عَلَيْهِ الخَبَرَ , inf. n. تَلْحِيجٌ; and عَلَيْهِ ↓ لَحْوَجَهُ , inf. n. لَحْوَجَةٌ; He rendered the news, or information, confused to him, and told him something different from that which was in his mind: (S, K:) or the phrase with the former verb signifies he told him news, or a piece of information, different * from that which was in his mind; and that with the latter verb, he rendered the news, or information, confused to him. (Az.) See 5.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
